summary: The create-pull-request job failed when the sync script attempted to push the generated branch to GitHub. GitHub rejected the push with HTTP 403 because nextjs-bot lacked permission to write to vercel/next.js.

evidence.quote: Error: Command failed with exit code 128 (Unknown system error -128): git push origin update/react/19.3.0-canary-142cfde8-20260422
evidence.reason: This identifies the failing operation as a Git push.

evidence.reason: GitHub explicitly reports that the authenticated actor lacks permission.

evidence.quote: fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/vercel/next.js/': The requested URL returned error: 403
evidence.reason: The HTTP 403 confirms authorization failure rather than a build or test failure.

suggested_fix: Configure the workflow authentication so the token used by git push grants nextjs-bot permission to write branches in vercel/next.js.
